name: The Ultimate Push Pull Legs System
tagline: A science-based 12-week periodized 6-day PPL program for maximum hypertrophy
description: A 12-week Push/Pull/Legs program structured across 3 progressive phases: Phase 1 (Weeks 1–6) is Base Hypertrophy with moderate volume and intensity; Phase 2 (Weeks 7–10) is High Intensity / Low Volume; Phase 3 (Weeks 11–12) is the Supercompensation phase with ultra-high volume. Train 6 days per week, rotating Push → Pull → Legs twice, with 1 full rest day.

activities.name: Bench Press
activities.notes: Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on the chest and explode up on each rep.

activities.name: Larsen Press (DB Bench Press — No Leg Drive)
activities.notes: Shoulder blades retracted and depressed. Slight arch in upper back. Zero leg drive.

activities.name: A1. Standing DB Shoulder Press (Press-Around)
activities.notes: Start with elbows in front, palms facing in. Rotate dumbbells so palms face forward as you press.

activities.name: A2. Pec Static Stretch
activities.notes: Hold the pec stretch at about 7/10 intensity.

activities.name: Cross-Body Cable Y-Raise (Side Delt)
activities.notes: Think about swinging the cable out and up as if drawing a sword from your side.

activities.name: Squeeze-Only Triceps Pressdown + Stretch-Only Overhead Triceps Extension
activities.notes: Do the second half of the ROM for pressdowns (the squeeze) and the first half of the ROM for overhead extensions (the stretch).

activities.name: N1-Style Cross-Body Triceps Extension
activities.notes: Extend your triceps with your arm more out to the side than a regular pressdown. Feel the stretch as the cable moves across your torso.

activities.name: Lat Pulldown — Feeder Sets
activities.notes: Gradually build weight over 4 sets. Set 1: RPE 4–5, Set 2: RPE 6–7, Set 3: RPE 7–8, Set 4: go to failure.

activities.name: Lat Pulldown — Failure Set + Dropset
activities.notes: After hitting failure at ~10 reps, strip the weight back 30–50% and do another 5 reps with controlled technique.

activities.name: Incline Chest-Supported Row (Omni-Grip)
activities.notes: Use 3 different grips for the 3 working sets (ideally going from wider to closer).

activities.name: A1. Bottom-Half DB Lat Pullover
activities.notes: Cut out the top half of the ROM; stay entirely in the stretched aspect of the lift.

activities.name: A2. Lat Static Stretch
activities.notes: Hold the lat stretch at about 7/10 intensity.

activities.name: Omni-Direction Face Pull
activities.notes: 1st set: low-to-high. 2nd set: mid-range. 3rd set: high-to-low.

activities.name: EZ-Bar Curl
activities.notes: Focus on contracting your biceps; minimize torso momentum.

activities.name: Bottom-Half Preacher Curl
activities.notes: Cut out the top half of the ROM; stay entirely in the stretched aspect of the lift.

activities.name: Squat
activities.notes: Sit back and down; keep your upper back tight to the bar.

activities.name: Pause Squat (Back-Off Set)
activities.notes: Drop weight ~25% from top set. 2-second pause at the bottom. Sit back and down, upper back tight.

activities.name: 45° Hyperextension / Barbell RDL
activities.notes: Maintain a neutral lower back; set your hips back; don't allow your spine to round.

activities.name: Walking Lunge
activities.notes: Take medium strides; minimize the amount you push off your rear leg.

activities.name: Seated Leg Curl
activities.notes: Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to move the weight.

activities.name: Leg Press Toe Press (Calf Raises)
activities.notes: Press all the way up to your toes; stretch your calves at the bottom; don't bounce.

activities.name: Cable Crunch
activities.notes: Hold a plate or DB to your chest and crunch hard.

activities.name: Close-Grip Barbell Incline Press
activities.notes: Wave-load the reps: heavy set of 8, heavier set of 5, then a back-off set of 12.

activities.name: Machine Shoulder Press
activities.notes: Don't stop between reps; keep smooth and controlled tension on the delts.

activities.name: Floor Skull Crusher
activities.notes: Keep upper arms perpendicular to the floor; fully extend at the top.

activities.name: Pec Deck
activities.notes: 5 full reps followed immediately by 15 partial reps in the stretched position.

activities.name: DB Lateral Raise
activities.notes: Lead with your elbows; squeeze at the top.

activities.name: Pull-Up (1 AMRAP Set)
activities.notes: Go to absolute failure. Record your rep count each week for progressive overload tracking.

activities.name: Kroc Row
activities.notes: Keep chest tall; keep elbow tucked in close to your torso; focus on the lat contraction.

activities.name: Cable Shrug-In
activities.notes: Pull your shoulder blades together and down at the top of the movement.

activities.name: Reverse Pec Deck (Rear Delt Fly)
activities.notes: Focus on rear delt contraction; avoid using traps to swing the weight.

activities.name: N1-Style Cross-Body Cable Bicep Curl
activities.notes: Curl across your torso to hit both the short and long head. Control the negative.

days.label: Legs #2 — Hamstrings, Glutes, Quads, Calves, Core

activities.name: Deadlift
activities.notes: Brace hard, push the floor away, keep your lats tight to protect your lower back.

activities.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
activities.notes: Maintain a neutral lower back; hinge at the hips and feel the stretch in the hamstrings.

activities.name: Leg Press
activities.notes: Use a controlled full range of motion; don't lock out your knees aggressively at the top.

activities.name: Glute-Ham Raise (GHR) / Nordic Ham Curl
activities.notes: Keep your hips straight; focus on hamstring contraction throughout the movement.

activities.name: Leg Extension
activities.notes: Control the weight with a 3–4 second negative on each rep.

activities.name: Seated Calf Raise
activities.notes: Press all the way up; get a full stretch at the bottom; don't bounce.

activities.name: Roman Chair Leg Raise
activities.notes: Keep your lower back pressed into the pad; control the movement throughout.

activities.name: Bench Press
activities.notes: Add 2.5–5 lbs over Week 1. Same technique: comfortable arch, quick pause, explode up.

activities.name: Larsen Press (DB Bench Press — No Leg Drive)
activities.notes: Increase load slightly if Week 1 felt easy. Zero leg drive.

activities.name: A1. Standing DB Shoulder Press (Press-Around)
activities.notes: Progressive overload: use slightly heavier DBs or add 1 rep vs Week 1.

activities.name: A2. Pec Static Stretch
activities.notes: Hold at 7/10 intensity.

activities.name: Cross-Body Cable Y-Raise (Side Delt)
activities.notes: Swing the cable out and up as if drawing a sword.

activities.name: Squeeze-Only Triceps Pressdown + Stretch-Only Overhead Triceps Extension
activities.notes: Maintain strong technique; add a small amount of load if possible.

activities.name: N1-Style Cross-Body Triceps Extension
activities.notes: Extend your triceps with your arm out to the side to maximize the stretch.

activities.name: Lat Pulldown — Feeder Sets
activities.notes: Build progressively. Final set to failure. Aim for one more rep on your last set vs Week 1.

activities.name: Lat Pulldown — Failure Set + Dropset
activities.notes: Dropset: strip 30–50% of load and do 5 controlled reps.

activities.name: Incline Chest-Supported Row (Omni-Grip)
activities.notes: Vary grip: wide, neutral, close.

activities.name: A1. Bottom-Half DB Lat Pullover
activities.notes: Stay in the stretched bottom half of the ROM.

activities.name: A2. Lat Static Stretch
activities.notes: 7/10 intensity.

activities.name: Omni-Direction Face Pull
activities.notes: 3 angle variations across 3 sets.

activities.name: EZ-Bar Curl
activities.notes: Minimize torso swing; add load if able to.

activities.name: Bottom-Half Preacher Curl
activities.notes: Stay in the stretch; control the negative.

activities.name: Squat
activities.notes: Add 5 lbs over Week 1 if form was clean.

activities.name: Pause Squat (Back-Off Set)
activities.notes: 2-second pause at bottom. Match or slightly exceed Week 1 load.

activities.name: 45° Hyperextension / Barbell RDL

activities.name: Walking Lunge
activities.notes: Medium strides; minimize push-off from rear leg.

activities.name: Seated Leg Curl
activities.notes: Squeeze your hamstrings at the top.

activities.name: Leg Press Toe Press (Calf Raises)
activities.notes: Full range; full stretch at bottom; don't bounce.

activities.name: Cable Crunch
activities.notes: Crunch hard at the bottom.

activities.name: Close-Grip Barbell Incline Press

activities.name: Machine Shoulder Press
activities.notes: Controlled tension; no lockout.

activities.name: Floor Skull Crusher
activities.notes: Keep upper arms perpendicular to the floor.

activities.name: Pec Deck
activities.notes: 5 full reps + 15 partials in the stretch.

activities.name: DB Lateral Raise
activities.notes: Lead with elbows; squeeze at the top.

activities.name: Pull-Up (1 AMRAP Set)
activities.notes: Aim to beat your Week 1 rep count.

activities.name: Kroc Row

activities.name: Cable Shrug-In
activities.notes: Full scapular retraction and depression.

activities.name: Reverse Pec Deck (Rear Delt Fly)
activities.notes: Rear delt focus; don't use your traps.

activities.name: N1-Style Cross-Body Cable Bicep Curl
activities.notes: Curl across your torso; control the negative.

activities.name: Glute-Ham Raise (GHR) / Nordic Ham Curl
